map.GRP 和 Reach 是一回事吗？: Are GRP and Reach the same thing?
map.→ 打开电视（广告/投放/效果）评估工具: -> Open the television (advertising / placement / effect) evaluation tool
map.不是。GRP（总收视点）= 收视率×频次，衡量总曝光强度；Reach（到达率）是: No. GRP (gross rating point) = rating x frequency and measures total exposure intensity; Reach is the share of people who saw the ad at least once. GRP = Reach x Frequency, and the two must be read together.

map.经典经验是 3 次（3+）起步才形成记忆，但过度曝光会浪费。快消高频品类可高些，: The classic rule of thumb is that 3 exposures (3 or more) are needed before recall forms, but over-exposure wastes budget. High-frequency consumer goods can go higher, low-frequency big-ticket items lower. The threshold depends on media strategy and budget; the tool only does the arithmetic.
map.给定费用算 CPM、CPRP（每收视点成本），对比不同频道/时段的性价比。: Given the cost, compute CPM and CPRP (cost per rating point) to compare the value of different channels and dayparts.
map.：目标观众 1000 万、插播 5 次、平均收视率 2%。GRP = 2%×5: : a target audience of 10 million with 5 insertions and an average rating of 2% gives GRP = 2% x 5 = 10, so a gross rating point of 10. With a reach ceiling of 40%, the effective frequency = GRP / reach = 10 / 40% = 2.5. At a cost of 500,000 CNY, CPM = 500,000 / (10 million x 40% / 1000) = 125 CNY per thousand.
